title: Co-area formula (2.8)-(2.9) and rectifiability of slices (Remark 2.10(2))
statement: Let m, k, ℓ ∈ ℕ with k > 0, n := m + k, M ⊆ ℝ^{n+ℓ} countably n-rectifiable, U ⊇ M open and f : ℝ^{n+ℓ} → ℝᵐ locally Lipschitz on U. (CoareaFormula) If moreover M is Hⁿ-measurable and θ is a positive locally integrable weight on M, then with J*^M_f(x) := coareaJacobian (approxTangentPlane n M θ x) f x: (a) for Hⁿ-a.e. x ∈ M there are P and L with HasWeightedApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M θ x P and HasTangentialDifferentialAt P f x L; (b) ∫_A J*^M_f dHⁿ = ∫_{ℝᵐ} Hᵏ(A ∩ f⁻¹{y}) dLᵐ(y) and (c) ∫_A g·J*^M_f dHⁿ = ∫_{ℝᵐ} ∫_{A ∩ f⁻¹{y}} g dHᵏ dLᵐ(y) for every Hⁿ-measurable A ⊆ M and every Hⁿ⌞A-measurable g : ℝ^{n+ℓ} → [0, ∞]. (SlicesAreRectifiable) If M is Hⁿ-measurable, then M ∩ f⁻¹{y} is countably k-rectifiable for Lᵐ-a.e. y ∈ ℝᵐ.
